newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Barlows sells household interests.
newsitem.headline: Barlows sells household interests.

text.p: Industrial holding firm Barlow Ltd said on Tuesday it had sold its household appliance manufacturing and distribution interests to Sovereign Capital Consortium for an undisclosed sum.
Consumer electric products no longer formed part of the group's core business, Barlows chairman Warren Clewlow said in a statement.

"Having looked at a number of options we are pleased that the sale of the business as a going concern to a consortium that includes the National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) has been satisfactorily concluded," he said.
The statement said Numsa was a partner in the consortium.
Philip Bellingan, Barlows executive director, said the conclusion of the transaction meant that refrigerator brand name Kelvinator would continue as a leading brand in South Africa.
"The consortium has contracted to assume all warranty obligations, and service and parts availability will be maintained," Bellingan said.
